run_pump_generate: run pump.py on a .pump file to generate C++ boilerplate code
build_pump_template: build a Pump template with $var and $for directives to generate repetitive C++ code
test_pump_parser: test the Pump parser by converting source text into an AST
refactor_pump_output: refactor generated Pump output by wrapping long lines to 80 characters
review_pump_tokenizer: review the Pump tokenizer that tokenizes source text into a stream of tokens
